# @llazyemail/template-runtime-display

> Pure functions that return HTML email fragments. No runtime dependencies. Node 24+. Named exports only.

- Repo: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@llazyemail/template-runtime-display
- README: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/README.md
- Agent guide: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Full API: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/llms-full.txt
- Sample: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/examples/compose.ts

## Public surface

```ts
import { document, footer, head, main } from '@llazyemail/template-runtime-display';

document({
  headHtml: head({ title: 'Weekly update', preview: 'Three things that shipped' }),
  mainHtml: main({
    heading: 'Weekly update',
    bodyText: 'Three things that shipped.',
    ctaLabel: 'Read',
    ctaUrl: 'https://example.com/update',
  }),
  footerHtml: footer({
    companyName: 'LLazyEmail',
    unsubscribeUrl: 'https://example.com/unsubscribe',
  }),
});
```

Also exported: `body({ mainHtml, footerHtml })`, `content({ content })`.

Omitted strings are empty. The button needs both `ctaLabel` and `ctaUrl`. Unsubscribe needs `unsubscribeUrl`. Props are raw HTML. `document` is deterministic and uses `<html lang="en">`.
